title: Assignment repository
interface: class AssignmentRepository(conn). open(asset_id, employee_id, handover_id) -> dict (started_at=now UTC ISO, ended_at None, return_id None). get(id) -> dict | None. get_open_for_asset(asset_id) -> dict | None (ended_at IS NULL). list_open_for_employee(employee_id) -> list[dict]. close(id, return_id) -> bool (sets ended_at=now and return_id; False when unknown or already closed). history_for_asset(asset_id) -> list[dict] newest first. Dict keys: id, asset_id, employee_id, handover_id, return_id, started_at, ended_at. repositories receive a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and call conn.commit() after every write; rows are returned as plain dicts with `is_...`/`active` booleans converted from 0/1

uses.connect/get_db: src/db.py: connect(path) -> sqlite3.Connection (row_factory=sqlite3.Row, schema ensured); get_db() -> current app connection; SCHEMA (tables employees, assets, handovers, assignments, audit_log)
